scene: A certain village nestled in the countryside. Modest cottages line a quiet dirt road. The sun shines on a peaceful rural community.
caption: "Once upon a time there lived in a certain village a little country girl"

scene: The same village. Townspeople gather in small groups, whispering and gesturing about someone.
caption: "The beauty of whom was everywhere the principal theme of conversation"

scene: Inside a modest country home. A mother holds her daughter close, her face full of warmth and devotion.
caption: "But particularly at her mother's, who was passionately fond of her"

scene: The interior of the home. A bright red riding-hood is draped over a chair, freshly made.
caption: "Her grandmother, who lived in another village, made her a present of a little red riding-hood"

scene: The village. The girl wears the red riding-hood, turning heads wherever she goes.
caption: "Which became her so well that every one called her Little Red Riding-Hood"

scene: Inside the family kitchen. A mother stands at a wooden table, having just finished preparing custards in small dishes.
caption: "One day her mother, having made some custards, said to her"

scene: The kitchen. The mother turns to face her daughter, who stands nearby listening.
caption: "Go, my dear, and see how thy grandmamma does, for I hear she has been very ill"

scene: The kitchen. The mother picks up a custard and a small pot of butter from the table.
action: Picking up the custard and butter
caption: "Carry her a custard, and this little pot of butter"

scene: The kitchen. The mother hands the custard and butter to her daughter, who accepts them carefully.
caption: "Carry her a custard, and this little pot of butter"

scene: Outside the cottage. The mother watches from the doorway as her daughter walks down the path toward the woods.
caption: "Carry her a custard, and this little pot of butter"

scene: Outside the village home. A dirt path leads away from the cottage toward distant trees.
caption: "Little Red Riding-Hood set out immediately to go to her grandmother"

scene: The path beyond the village. Open countryside stretches ahead, with a forest visible in the distance.
caption: "Who lived in another village"

scene: A dense forest. Tall trees tower overhead, their branches forming a canopy. Sunlight filters through in patches.
caption: "As she was going through the wood she met with Gaffer Wolf"

scene: The forest path. The wolf watches from the shadows as the girl approaches, licking his lips.
caption: "As she was going through the wood she met with Gaffer Wolf"

scene: A forest path. A large grey wolf stands in the middle of the trail, blocking the way.
caption: "Who had a very great mind to eat her up"

scene: The forest edge. In the distance, several faggot-makers chop wood among the trees.
caption: "But he dared not, because of some faggot-makers hard by in the forest"

scene: The forest path. The wolf approaches the girl and speaks to her.
caption: "He asked her whither she was going so early"

scene: The forest path. The girl stands before the wolf, her basket in hand, unaware of danger.
caption: "The poor child, who did not know that it was dangerous to stay and hear a wolf talk"

scene: The forest path. The girl speaks openly to the wolf, gesturing toward her grandmother's village.
caption: "Said: 'I am going to see my grandmamma and carry her a custard and a little pot of butter from my mamma'"

scene: The forest path. The wolf tilts his head curiously, asking about the distance.
caption: "'Does she live far off?' said the Wolf"

scene: The forest path. Beyond the trees, a mill is visible in the distance. The girl points toward it.
caption: "'It is beyond that mill you see there, at the first house in the village'"

scene: The forest path. The wolf grins and proposes a race, his tail swishing.
caption: "'Well, and I'll go and see her too. I'll go this way and you go that'"

scene: The forest path. The wolf and the girl face each other, each preparing to take a different direction.
caption: "'We shall see who will be there soonest'"

scene: The forest. The wolf bolts through the trees at full speed, his paws kicking up dirt and leaves.
action: Running as fast as he could
caption: "The Wolf began to run as fast as he could, taking the nearest way"

scene: A winding forest path. The girl strolls leisurely along the longer route.
caption: "While the little girl went by that farthest about"

scene: A forest clearing with tall nut-bearing trees. The girl kneels on the ground.
caption: "Diverting herself in gathering nuts"

scene: A sunlit forest glade. Colorful butterflies flutter among wildflowers.
caption: "Running after butterflies"

scene: A forest path lined with small wildflowers. The girl bends to pick blossoms.
caption: "And making nosegays of such little flowers as she met with"

scene: A small stone cottage at the edge of a village. Smoke curls from the chimney. The wolf arrives at the front door.
caption: "The Wolf was not long before he got to the old woman's house"

scene: The cottage exterior. The wolf stands on his hind legs and knocks at the wooden door.
caption: "He knocked at the door--tap, tap"

scene: Inside the cottage. An elderly woman sits up in a rocking chair near the fireplace, hearing the knock.
caption: "'Who's there?'"

scene: Outside the cottage door. The wolf speaks in a disguised, high-pitched voice.
caption: "'Your grandchild, Little Red Riding-Hood,' replied she"

scene: Outside the cottage door. The wolf continues his ruse, mentioning the custard and butter.
caption: "'Who has brought you a custard and a little pot of butter from mamma'"

scene: Outside the cottage door. The wolf softens his voice further, speaking sweetly.
caption: "The Wolf cried out to her, softening his voice as much as he could"

scene: Outside the cottage door. The wolf instructs the grandmother on how to open the door.
caption: "'Pull the bobbin, and the latch will go up'"

scene: The cottage doorway. The wolf reaches for the small wooden bobbin beside the door.
caption: "The Wolf pulled the bobbin, and the door opened"

scene: The cottage doorway. The latch lifts and the door swings inward.
caption: "The Wolf pulled the bobbin, and the door opened"

scene: Inside the cottage. The wolf bursts through the doorway, lunging at the grandmother.
action: Wolf falling upon the old woman
caption: "He fell upon the good woman and ate her up in a moment"

scene: Inside the cottage. The room falls silent. The wolf stands alone, sated.
caption: "For it was above three days that he had not touched a bit"

scene: The cottage interior. The wolf shuts the door behind him, securing it.
caption: "He then shut the door"

scene: The cottage hallway. The wolf pads toward the bedroom, his claws clicking on the floor.
caption: "And went into the grandmother's bed"

scene: Grandmother's bedroom. The wolf climbs onto the bed, pulling the covers over himself.
caption: "And went into the grandmother's bed"

scene: Grandmother's bed. The wolf settles under the bed-clothes, his eyes gleaming in the dim light.
caption: "Expecting Little Red Riding-Hood"

scene: The cottage exterior. The girl approaches the door, her basket of gifts in hand.
caption: "Who came some time afterward and knocked at the door--tap, tap"

scene: The cottage exterior. The girl raises her hand and knocks gently.
caption: "Who came some time afterward and knocked at the door--tap, tap"

scene: Inside the cottage. The wolf, disguised in bed, calls out in a rough, deep voice.
caption: "'Who's there?'"

scene: Outside the cottage door. The girl starts at the sound of the deep voice.
caption: "Little Red Riding-Hood, hearing the big voice of the Wolf, was at first afraid"

scene: Outside the cottage door. The girl pauses, her hand on the doorframe, thinking.
caption: "Little Red Riding-Hood, hearing the big voice of the Wolf, was at first afraid"

scene: Outside the cottage door. The girl reasons that her grandmother must have caught a cold.
caption: "But believing her grandmother had got a cold and was hoarse"

scene: Outside the cottage door. The girl speaks, announcing herself and her gifts.
caption: "Answered: ''Tis your grandchild, Little Red Riding-Hood'"

scene: Outside the cottage door. The girl explains what she carries.
caption: "'Who has brought you a custard and a little pot of butter mamma sends you'"

scene: Inside the cottage. The wolf softens his voice, speaking sweetly from the bed.
caption: "The Wolf cried out to her, softening his voice as much as he could"

scene: Outside the cottage door. The wolf instructs the girl to open the latch.
caption: "'Pull the bobbin, and the latch will go up'"

scene: The cottage doorway. The girl reaches for the bobbin beside the door.
caption: "Little Red Riding-Hood pulled the bobbin, and the door opened"

scene: The cottage doorway. The latch lifts and the door swings open.
caption: "Little Red Riding-Hood pulled the bobbin, and the door opened"

scene: Inside the cottage. The girl steps through the doorway into the dim interior.
caption: "The Wolf, seeing her come in, hid himself under the bed-clothes"

scene: Grandmother's bedroom. The wolf, seeing the girl enter, ducks beneath the bed-clothes.
caption: "The Wolf, seeing her come in, hid himself under the bed-clothes"

scene: Grandmother's bedroom. The wolf, hidden beneath the covers, speaks to the girl.
caption: "'Put the custard and the little pot of butter upon the stool'"

scene: Grandmother's bedroom. A small wooden stool sits beside the bed, empty.
caption: "'Put the custard and the little pot of butter upon the stool'"

scene: Grandmother's bedroom. The wolf invites the girl to join him in bed.
caption: "'And come and lie down with me'"

scene: Grandmother's bedroom. The girl places the custard and butter on the wooden stool.
action: Putting the custard and butter upon the stool
caption: "Little Red Riding-Hood put the custard and the little pot of butter upon the stool"

scene: Grandmother's bedroom. The girl approaches the bed, her eyes on the figure beneath the covers.
caption: "And then went into bed"

scene: Grandmother's bedroom. The girl climbs onto the bed and pulls the covers over herself.
caption: "And then went into bed"

scene: Grandmother's bed. The girl lies beside the figure and stares at the night-clothes.
action: Looking at the wolf in grandmother's night-clothes
caption: "Being greatly amazed to see how her grandmother looked in her night-clothes"

scene: Grandmother's bed. The girl's eyes widen as she notices the large arms.
caption: "Said to her: 'Grandmamma, what great arms you have got!'"

scene: Grandmother's bed. The wolf stretches his massive arms and responds.
caption: "'That is the better to hug thee, my dear'"

scene: Grandmother's bed. The girl glances down at the large legs beneath the covers.
caption: "'Grandmamma, what great legs you have got!'"

scene: Grandmother's bed. The wolf flexes his powerful legs and answers.
caption: "'That is to run the better, my child'"

scene: Grandmother's bed. The girl notices the enormous ears sticking up from the pillow.
caption: "'Grandmamma, what great ears you have got!'"

scene: Grandmother's bed. The wolf's ears twitch as he replies calmly.
caption: "'That is to hear the better, my child'"

scene: Grandmother's bed. The girl stares into the large, glaring eyes.
caption: "'Grandmamma, what great eyes you have got!'"

scene: Grandmother's bed. The wolf's eyes flash in the dim light as he answers.
caption: "'It is to see the better, my child'"

scene: Grandmother's bed. The girl notices the sharp, white teeth glistening.
caption: "'Grandmamma, what great teeth you have got!'"

scene: Grandmother's bed. The wolf opens his jaws wide, revealing rows of fangs.
caption: "'That is to eat thee up'"

scene: Grandmother's bed. The wolf lunges from the covers, falling upon the girl.
action: Wolf falling upon Little Red Riding-Hood
caption: "And, saying these words, this wicked wolf fell upon Little Red Riding-Hood"

scene: Grandmother's bed. The girl tries to escape but the wolf is too quick.
caption: "And, saying these words, this wicked wolf fell upon Little Red Riding-Hood"

scene: Grandmother's bed. The wolf devours the girl completely.
caption: "And ate her all up"

scene: Grandmother's bed. The bed is empty. The room falls silent. Only the rumpled covers remain.
caption: "And ate her all up"
